Class MetaData

java.lang.Object
org.osgi.test.cases.dmt.tc3.tbc.MetaNode.MetaData.MetaData
public class MetaData extends Object
This test case validates if DmtException.METADATA_MISMATCH is thrown when the Metadata does not allow the specified action.
